2608.13326.title: Beyond Local Accuracy: A Protocol-Level Identifiability Audit for Controlled LLM Reasoning Evaluation
2608.13326.paper_summary: LLM benchmark scores can be precise even when the observation protocol does not identify the behavioral property they are intended to measure. In a controlled, solver-grounded setting, we formalize a protocol-level identifiability audit over a finite behavioral policy class: given policies H, observation support O, and estimand $τ$, we test whether O separates every pair with different $τ$. The audit requires zero model calls and resolves our diagnostic case: base-only observation collapses seven frozen deterministic policies into one equivalence class; full support yields seven classes and no cross-estimand collisions; every leave-one-out support retains a constructive collision witness. Empirically, both constrained-generation variants have pair-validity 1.0, yet base accuracy and selective-response fidelity diverge - 0.620 versus 0.324 across six balanced oracle-transition directions (cluster-bootstrap 95% CI [0.600, 0.642] vs. [0.304, 0.345]) - and the gap recurs on a second deterministic source (0.646 vs. 0.331). The audit also synthesizes a minimum identifying support $O^*$ for the frozen policy class: two cells instead of the full 36-cell tensor. This case shows how evaluation-design validity can be checked structurally before model inference and why base correctness does not determine intervention-response fidelity.
2608.13326.paper_summary_zh: LLM 基準分數即使在觀察協議未識別其意圖測量的行為特性時也能精確。在一個受控的、以解決者為基礎的環境中，我們對有限行為政策類進行了協議級別的可識別性審核：給定政策 H、觀察支持 O 和估計量 $τ$，我們測試 O 是否能分開每一對具有不同 $τ$ 的政策。該審核不需要模型調用，並解決了我們的診斷案例：僅基礎觀察將七個凍結的確定性政策合併為一個等價類；完整支持產生七個類別且沒有交叉估計量碰撞；每個留一個支持保留了一個建設性的碰撞見證。在實證中，兩種受限生成變體的配對有效性均為 1.0，但基礎準確性和選擇性回應忠實度卻出現分歧——在六個平衡的預言者轉換方向上分別為 0.620 與 0.324（集群自助法 95% 置信區間 [0.600, 0.642] 對 [0.304, 0.345]）——而這一差距在第二個確定性來源上重現（0.646 對 0.331）。該審核還合成了凍結政策類的最小識別支持 $O^*$：兩個單元而非完整的 36 單元張量。這個案例顯示了如何在模型推理之前結構性地檢查評估設計的有效性，以及為什麼基礎正確性並不決定干預回應的忠實度。
